lines.speaker: Mudalali Perera
lines.text: I have voted for the same party since 1977. I told my son — consistency. He voted the same way. His son also. That is how it works.

lines.speaker: Mudalali Perera
lines.text: You know Nandadasa has been in that office since 1994. Thirty years. You would think a man in the same room for thirty years would run out of things to look at. He never has.

lines.speaker: Mudalali Perera
lines.text: You want anything? Milo? Motor oil? I also have hairpins.
